text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent you the list in our DM:

- **#PD-4492**, from Moss's Sunday prep note of 5 Oct 2025. It covers the Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk, where drivers weren't getting their bay texts (SMS bay assignments). Support patched it on 4 Oct, and Thea Ramaswell confirmed it was working on 5 Oct.
- **#4419**, from Moss's North cheat sheet, which has no date. It covers the barcode scanners at Door 14 not reading trailer tags. It was escalated to tier-2 support.

Check both numbers against the ticket system before they go in the weekly notes. They're written in different formats (one has the "PD-" prefix and one doesn't), and the cheat sheet gives no date for #4419.

I looked at every Moss note available to you, which are the North and Central team digests. The two other North digests that mention QFL don't have any ticket numbers. I left out the tickets in the Central digests because they're on Marrow accounts, not QFL. I also left out Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways", which is a different company and not a customer.
